title: Encouraging Young Singaporeans to Pursue Overseas Immersions
what_it_is: Encouraging Young Singaporeans to Pursue Overseas Immersions

sections.label: Overseas programme and study award numbers
sections.summary: Since 2015 about 1,900 university, 1,100 polytechnic and 200 ITE students benefited, and 432 SkillsFuture study awards were given out.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Since 2015, the programme has benefited about 1,900 University students and more than 1,100 Polytechnic students and 200 ITE students after its expansion to include this group of youths.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: IE Singapore's SkillsFuture Study Award for International Business is targeted at Singaporeans with at least three years of working experience in a global role.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Since its launch in October 2015, a total of 432 study awards have been given out.

sections.label: Student overseas programme participation rates
sections.summary: More than a quarter of ITE, nearly half of polytechnic and close to two-thirds of university students join an overseas programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Today, more than a quarter of ITE students, nearly half of Polytechnic students and close to two-thirds of university students choose to participate in an overseas programme during their course of study.

sections.label: Student feedback on overseas stints
sections.summary: Feedback from students on their overseas stints has been positive.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Feedback from students on their overseas stints has been positive.
